title: Brinehaven and the Stormwake Coast
text:
The world grows east: a new coast, a second town, and a cleaner, more natural look.

✨ The map is a third bigger. Past Frostpeak's eastern wall, over Stormwake Pass, lies the Stormwake Coast, a new zone for levels 12 to 15
✨ Brinehaven, a walled harbour town with its own inn, temple, smithy, general store, market, fish market, piers, boats and a lighthouse on the headland
✨ Make Brinehaven your home: talk to Della at the Gull & Anchor, and your hearth takes you there
✨ Ten new quests from Harbourmaster Corwin, Tidemother Ysra, Garrick the smith and Della, starting with Captain Oriel's 'Sails Beyond the Mountains' at level 12
✨ Six new monsters, Captain Blackwake (elite) at Wreckers' Cove, and Thalassor the Tidewyrm (boss) at the Drowned Shrine
✨ Ferry: once you have found Brinehaven on foot, Fisher Bram at Mirrowmere and Ferryman Odo in Brinehaven sail between the two for 5 gold
⬆️ When you die and release, your spirit returns to the nearest safe haven (Hearthmere, Brinehaven, Frostwatch or Emberwatch) instead of always Hearthmere
⬆️ Graphics: fire, lava and bright colours keep their real colour instead of washing out to yellow-white, softer and smoother shadows, and a calmer, more natural colour grade
⬆️ Mithril and Sunpetal also grow on the coast
• Barbarian: auto attacks and every ability deal about 12% less damage
• Hunter: auto attacks and every ability deal about 12% less damage, and the wolf deals 15% less
⬆️ Crafting: Make buttons always respond. If something is missing you are told exactly what (the materials and how many, or which anvil to stand at), and the Blacksmithing page shows live whether you are at an anvil
⬆️ Garrick's forge in Brinehaven is a working anvil, and Garrick upgrades gear just like Doran
⬆️ Forge upgrades always respond too, and say how much gold or which material you are short
🔧 The action bar, menu buttons, chat and XP bar no longer overlap on smaller or narrower screens: the menu wraps or moves above the bar, and the chat makes room
